verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can export content at any time and choose Markdown (or the native Any-Block format), and they promise your data leaves with you, which meets the 'exportable in open formats' bar for the researcher's archive. Community complaints that on-disk storage is opaque Electron blobs and not raw Markdown concern native storage, not export, so they lower confidence but do not contradict the export capability. Missing for 10: documentation that Any-Block/JSON is an open, specified format; detail on export fidelity (properties, relations, links, files); independent hands-on confirmation of full-archive Markdown export.
